newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht, interbank rate steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht, interbank rate steady in late trade.

text.p: The Thai baht barely moved in late quiet trade on Monday as most market players had squared their year-end positions, dealers said.
"Market activities are very thin as dealers have squared their year-end positions," said one dealer at a European bank.
The baht was traded at 25.600-25.610 to the dollar near the close against 25.600-25.605 in the morning, dealers said. The baht was quoted at 25.610-25.620 late on Friday.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.57 against 25.58 on Friday.
The overnight interbank rate was unchanged at 12.00 percent, dealers said.
"The interbank rate is likely to rise slightly tomorrow. But trading will remain sluggish as most banks have already squared their positions," a dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium rose to 9.00/10.00 satangs per dollar in late trading against 8.75/9.25 in the morning.
